# REFERENCE

# The Dushpek Language Reference

Dushpek is a small programming language. This reference is complete: it
describes everything the language and its toolchain do. Where Dushpek
differs from languages you may know, the difference is deliberate, so follow
this document rather than habit.

Every example in this reference was run with the real toolchain, and the
output shown is exactly what it printed.

## 1. Running programs

Dushpek source files use the extension `.dus`. The toolchain is a
single program named `dushpek`:

```
dushpek run program.dus      # check and run a program
dushpek check program.dus    # only check it for errors, without running it
```

A program reads from standard input and writes to standard output. If an
error occurs, `dushpek` prints a message to standard error and exits with
status 1. Output printed before the error is kept.

A program may run at most 50,000,000 steps and nest at most 10,000 function
calls. Exceeding either limit is an error.

## 2. Lexical structure

**Layout.** Spaces, tabs, line breaks and indentation have no meaning; use
them freely for readability. A comment starts with `//` and runs to
the end of the line.

**Statement terminator.** Simple statements (declarations, assignments,
calls, printing, jumps, `Pohuwu`, `Kewi`, `Gosh`) end with
`.`. Compound statements such as conditionals and loops do not need
one after them, but their syntax is shown in full below.

**Names** of variables, functions and labels are made of letters, digits
and `_`, and must not start with a digit. Names are case-sensitive.

**Keywords** are reserved and cannot be used as names. They are
case-sensitive and must be written exactly as shown:

| Keyword | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Dak` | logical or |
| `Drix` | part of: counting loop |
| `Dru` | part of: switch statement |
| `Ebi` | part of: print statement |
| `Eshdoyi` | part of: repeat-until loop |
| `Geklabik` | the boolean value true |
| `Gihe` | part of: while loop, counting loop |
| `Gipolu` | part of: counting loop |
| `Gosh` | part of: continue statement |
| `Gukdidok` | logical not |
| `Hehokgi` | part of: switch statement, while loop, counting loop |
| `Hishyeko` | part of: switch statement |
| `Ihedrux` | part of: switch statement |
| `Kewi` | part of: break statement |
| `Kobihek` | part of: switch statement, while loop, counting loop |
| `Koke` | part of: variable declaration |
| `Lesh` | the boolean value false |
| `Liliga` | the value none |
| `Okdro` | logical and |
| `Peshdro` | part of: repeat-until loop |
| `Pohuwu` | part of: return statement |
| `Puwadish` | part of: while loop |
| `Uxdrush` | part of: jump |
| `Wexdush` | part of: counting loop |
| `Wuhadi` | part of: write statement |
| `Yokyi` | part of: function declaration |
| `Yopok` | part of: conditional jump |

The builtin function names (section 9) are also reserved.

**Literals.** Integers are written in decimal (`0`, `42`, `1000`); there are
no fractions. A negative number is written with a minus sign (`-5`). Strings
are written between double quotes, such as `"hello"`. Inside a string, `\n`
is a line break, `\t` a tab, `\"` a double quote and `\\` a backslash.
Booleans are `Geklabik` and `Lesh`. The value `Liliga` means "no
value".

## 3. Values

| Type | Examples | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| integer | `0`, `-7`, `123` | 64-bit; overflow wraps around |
| string | `"hi"`, `""` | a sequence of characters; cannot be changed in place |
| boolean | `Geklabik`, `Lesh` | the only values allowed as conditions |
| list | `[1, 2, 3]`, `[]`, `["a", 1]` | mutable; may mix types |
| none | `Liliga` | "no value"; returned by functions that return nothing |

Lists are shared, not copied: assigning a list to another variable, or
passing it to a function, gives access to the same list.

```
Yokyi addOne(xs) {
    Oxba(xs, 1).
}

Koke mine := [5].
addOne(mine).
Ebi mine.
```

Output:

```
[5, 1]
```

Printing shows integers in decimal, strings without quotes, booleans and
`Liliga` as their keywords, and lists in brackets with strings quoted.

## 4. Variables and simple statements

A variable must be declared before it is used:

```
Koke <name> := <expression>.
```

Assignment changes an existing variable. Assigning to a name that was never
declared is an error.

```
<name> := <expression>.
```

Each function has one flat set of variables. A variable declared anywhere in
a function, including inside a loop or a branch, is visible from that point
to the end of the function. Declaring an existing variable again simply
assigns to it. The top-level code of a program has its own variables, which
functions cannot see.

`Ebi` prints a value followed by a line break. `Wuhadi` prints a
value without a line break.

```
Ebi <expression>.
```

```
Wuhadi <expression>.
```

```
Koke x := 5.
x := x + 2.
Koke name := "Ada".
Ebi name ++ " has " ++ x ++ " apples".
Koke flag := x > 6.
Ebi flag.
Ebi Liliga.
```

Output:

```
Ada has 7 apples
Geklabik
Liliga
```

## 5. Expressions

### Operators

| Operator | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `-x` | negation |
| `Gukdidok x` | logical not |
| `a * b` | multiplication |
| `a / b` | integer division (see below) |
| `a % b` | remainder (see below) |
| `a + b` | addition |
| `a - b` | subtraction |
| `a ++ b` | joining text (see below) |
| `a == b` | equal |
| `a /= b` | not equal |
| `a < b`, `a <= b`, `a > b`, `a >= b` | ordering |
| `a Okdro b` | logical and |
| `a Dak b` | logical or |

Note the spellings: assignment is `:=` and equality is `==`.

### Grouping and precedence

**All binary operators have the same precedence and group from left to
right.** There is no "multiplication first" rule: `2 + 3 * 4` means
`(2 + 3) * 4`. This applies to every binary operator, including comparisons
and `Okdro`/`Dak`, so `a < b Okdro c < d` means
`((a < b) Okdro c) < d`; write `(a < b) Okdro (c < d)` instead. Negation
and `Gukdidok` bind tighter than any binary operator. Parentheses group explicitly.

```
Ebi 2 + 3 * 4.
Ebi 10 - 4 - 3.
Ebi (2 + 3) * 4.
Ebi 2 + (3 * 4).
```

Output:

```
20
3
20
14
```

### Order of evaluation

**The two operands of a binary operator are evaluated right operand first**,
then the left one.

```
Yokyi show(x) {
    Ebi "evaluating " ++ x.
    Pohuwu x.
}

Ebi show(10) - show(4).
```

Output:

```
evaluating 4
evaluating 10
6
```

**Arguments of a function call are evaluated from right to left**: the last
argument first. They are still passed in the order written.

```
Yokyi show(x) {
    Ebi "evaluating " ++ x.
    Pohuwu x.
}

Yokyi pair(a, b) {
    Pohuwu a ++ b.
}

Ebi pair(show(1), show(2)).
```

Output:

```
evaluating 2
evaluating 1
12
```

### Integer arithmetic

Division of integers gives an integer. **The exact result is rounded up, toward positive infinity**, so
`7 / 2` is `4` and `-7 / 2` is `-3`. The remainder `a % b` is always `a - b * (a / b)` using that
division, so its sign follows from the rounding rule. Dividing by zero is an
error.

```
Ebi 7 / 2.
Ebi -7 / 2.
Ebi 7 % 2.
Ebi -7 % 2.
Ebi 6 / 3.
```

Output:

```
4
-3
-1
-1
2
```

### Text

`++` converts both operands to text (as printing would show them)
and joins them. `+` only adds integers.

```
Ebi "n = " ++ 5.
Ebi "a" ++ "b" ++ "c".
```

Output:

```
n = 5
abc
```

Strings can be compared with `<`, `<=`, `>` and `>=`, character by character
(by character code). Comparing values of different types with `==` gives
`Lesh`; ordering them is an error.

### Lists and indexing

`x[i]` is element `i` of list `x`, or the one-character string at position
`i` of string `x`. **Indexes start at 1**: the first element
is `x[1]`. List elements can be replaced with `x[i] := value.`.

```
<name>[<index>] := <expression>.
```

```
Koke xs := [10, 20, 30].
Ebi xs[1].
xs[1] := 99.
Ebi xs.
Koke word := "abc".
Ebi word[1].
```

Output:

```
10
[99, 20, 30]
a
```

**An index outside the list wraps around**: it is taken modulo the length,
so one past the last element is the first element again, and negative
indexes count back from the end. Indexing an empty list or string is an
error.

```
Koke xs := [10, 20, 30].
Ebi xs[3].
Ebi xs[4].
Ebi xs[-1].
```

Output:

```
30
10
20
```

Two lists are equal (`==`) when they have the same length and equal
elements.

```
Koke a := [1, 2].
Koke b := [1, 2].
Koke c := a.
Oxba(c, 3).
Ebi a.
Yopok a /= c, endif1.
Ebi "a equals c".
endif1:
Yopok a /= [1, 2, 3], else3.
Ebi "a equals a new list with the same elements".
Uxdrush endif2.
else3:
Ebi "a does not equal a new list with the same elements".
endif2:
```

Output:

```
[1, 2, 3]
a equals c
a equals a new list with the same elements
```

### Logic and conditions

Conditions must be booleans: there is no "truthiness", and using an integer,
string, list or `Liliga` as a condition is an error. The operands of
`Okdro`, `Dak` and `Gukdidok` must also be booleans.

`Okdro` and `Dak` evaluate their right operand only when needed: if the
left operand of `Okdro` is `Lesh`, or the left operand of `Dak`
is `Geklabik`, the right operand is not evaluated.

```
Yokyi check(name, result) {
    Ebi "checking " ++ name.
    Pohuwu result.
}

Yopok Gukdidok (check("left", Geklabik) Dak check("right", Lesh)), endif1.
Ebi "yes".
endif1:
Yopok Gukdidok (check("left", Lesh) Okdro check("right", Geklabik)), else3.
Ebi "yes".
Uxdrush endif2.
else3:
Ebi "no".
endif2:
```

Output:

```
checking left
yes
checking left
no
```

## 6. Control flow

### Choosing by value

```
Dru <expression> Ihedrux
<literal>, ...: Hehokgi
    <statements>
Kobihek
Hishyeko Hehokgi
    <statements>
Kobihek Kobihek
```

- The `<literal> ...` part may appear any number of times, including not at all.
- The `Hishyeko Hehokgi ...` part is optional.

The expression is evaluated once and compared with each literal in order,
using `==`. Literals are integers or strings, and must all be
different. Only the statements of the matching case run (or the default part,
if none matches and there is one). `Kewi` inside it refers to the enclosing loop, not
to this statement.

```
Gipolu d := 1 Wexdush 4 Gihe Hehokgi
    Dru d Ihedrux
    1: Hehokgi
        Ebi "one".
    Kobihek
    2, 3: Hehokgi
        Ebi "two or three".
    Kobihek
    Hishyeko Hehokgi
        Ebi "something else".
    Kobihek Kobihek
Kobihek
```

Output:

```
one
two or three
two or three
something else
```

### While loops

```
Puwadish <condition> Gihe Hehokgi
    <statements>
Kobihek
```

The condition is tested before each pass; the loop ends when it is
`Lesh`.

```
Koke n := 1.
Puwadish n < 100 Gihe Hehokgi
    n := n * 2.
Kobihek
Ebi n.
```

Output:

```
128
```

### Repeat-until loops

```
Eshdoyi
    <statements>
Peshdro <condition>.
```

The statements run once, then again **until** the condition is `Geklabik`.
The condition is tested after each pass.

```
Koke n := 0.
Eshdoyi
    n := n + 3.
Peshdro n > 10.
Ebi n.
```

Output:

```
12
```

### Counting loops

```
Gipolu <name> := <start> Wexdush <limit> Drix <step> Gihe Hehokgi
    <statements>
Kobihek
```

- The `Drix ...` part is optional.

The start, limit and step are evaluated once, before the loop begins; the
step defaults to `1` and must not be `0`. The variable starts at the start
value and changes by the step after each pass. The loop runs while the variable has not passed the
limit; **the limit itself is included**.

```
Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush 5 Gihe Hehokgi
    Wuhadi i ++ " ".
Kobihek
Ebi "".
Gipolu i := 10 Wexdush 1 Drix -3 Gihe Hehokgi
    Wuhadi i ++ " ".
Kobihek
Ebi "".
```

Output:

```
1 2 3 4 5 
10 7 4 1 
```

### Leaving loops early

```
Kewi.
```

```
Gosh.
```

`Kewi` leaves the innermost loop. `Gosh` skips to the next pass of
the innermost loop (for a counting or for loop, the update still happens).

```
Yokyi div_(a, b) {
    Koke q := a / b.
    Koke r := a - (b * q).
    Yopok r == 0, endif3.
    Yopok r < 0 == (a < 0), endif4.
    Yopok r < 0 /= (b < 0), else6.
    q := q + 1.
    Uxdrush endif5.
else6:
    q := q - 1.
endif5:
endif4:
endif3:
    Pohuwu q.
}

Yokyi mod_(a, b) {
    Pohuwu a - (b * div_(a, b)).
}

Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush 10 Gihe Hehokgi
    Yopok mod_(i, 2) /= 0, endif1.
    Gosh.
endif1:
    Yopok i <= 7, endif2.
    Kewi.
endif2:
    Wuhadi i ++ " ".
Kobihek
Ebi "".
```

Output:

```
1 3 5 7 
```

### Labels and jumps
Dushpek has no if statement; decisions are made with conditional jumps.

A label marks a position in a function. It does not end with `.`:

```
<label>:
```

A jump continues execution at a label in the same function:

```
Uxdrush <label>.
```

A conditional jump jumps only if the condition is `Geklabik`; otherwise
execution continues with the next statement:

```
Yopok <condition>, <label>.
```

Each label name may be defined only once in a function. Jumps may go
forward or backward, and into or out of any block in the same function.

```
Koke n := 7.
Yopok n >= 5, else2.
Ebi "small".
Uxdrush endif1.
else2:
Yopok n >= 10, else3.
Ebi "medium".
Uxdrush endif1.
else3:
Ebi "large".
endif1:
```

Output:

```
medium
```

## 7. Functions

```
Yokyi <name>(<parameter>, ...) {
    <statements>
}
```

- The list of parameters may be empty.

Functions are declared at the top level of a program, not inside other
statements, and may be called before their declaration. Calling a function
with the wrong number of arguments is an error. Recursion is allowed.

```
Pohuwu <expression>.
```

- `<expression>` is optional.

`Pohuwu` ends the function and gives back the value, or `Liliga`
without one. A function that ends without `Pohuwu` returns `Liliga`.
A `Pohuwu` in top-level code ends the program.

A call can be used as a statement, which discards its result:

```
<function>(<argument>, ...).
```

- The list of arguments may be empty.

```
Yokyi square(x) {
    Pohuwu x * x.
}

Yokyi fact(n) {
    Yopok n > 1, endif1.
    Pohuwu 1.
endif1:
    Pohuwu n * fact(n - 1).
}

Yokyi greet(name) {
    Ebi "Hello, " ++ name.
}

Ebi square(7).
Ebi fact(10).
greet("Lin").
Koke r := greet("Max").
Ebi r.
```

Output:

```
49
3628800
Hello, Lin
Hello, Max
Liliga
```

## 8. Errors

Errors found before running, such as syntax errors, unknown names and wrong
argument counts, stop the program before anything runs. Errors found while
running stop it at that point. In both cases, the message names the line.

```
Ebi "before".
Ebi 1 / 0.
Ebi "after".
```

Output:

```
before
error: line 2: division by zero
```

## 9. Builtin functions

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `Yik` | `(x)`: the number of elements of list `x`, or the number of characters of string `x`. |
| `Oxba` | `(xs, v)`: appends `v` to the end of list `xs` (changing it) and returns `Liliga`. |
| `Yawishbo` | `(v)`: converts any value to the string that printing it would show. |
| `Bupuxbo` | `(s)`: converts a string of decimal digits (optionally with a leading `-`, surrounding spaces allowed) to an integer. An integer is returned unchanged. Anything else is an error. |
| `Pewexpo` | `()`: reads the next line of standard input and returns it as a string without the line ending, or `Liliga` when there is no more input. |

```
Koke xs := [3, 1].
Oxba(xs, 4).
Ebi Yik(xs).
Ebi Yik("hello").
Ebi Yawishbo(42) ++ "!".
Ebi Bupuxbo("12") + 1.
Ebi Pewexpo().
Ebi Pewexpo().
Ebi Pewexpo().
```

Given this standard input:

```
first line
second line
```

Output:

```
3
5
42!
13
first line
second line
Liliga
```

## 10. A complete program

This program reads integers, one per line, until the input ends, and prints
how many there were, their sum and the largest.

```
Koke total := 0.
Koke seen := 0.
Koke best := 0.
Koke line := Pewexpo().
Puwadish line /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi
    Koke n := Bupuxbo(line).
    Yopok seen /= 0, else2.
    best := n.
    Uxdrush endif1.
else2:
    Yopok n <= best, endif1.
    best := n.
endif1:
    total := total + n.
    seen := seen + 1.
    line := Pewexpo().
Kobihek
Ebi "count " ++ seen.
Ebi "sum " ++ total.
Ebi "max " ++ best.
```

Given this standard input:

```
4
-2
17
9
```

Output:

```
count 4
sum 28
max 17
```

## Task ID: t4-lisp

# Lisp interpreter

Standard input holds a program in a small Lisp. Write a Dushpek program
that runs it.

**Reading.** The program is a sequence of forms. Tokens are `(`, `)` and
atoms: an atom is a run of characters other than spaces, line breaks and
parentheses. A form is an atom or a parenthesized list of forms; lists may
span lines. The parentheses are always balanced.

**Values** are integers, the booleans `#t` and `#f`, the empty list, pairs
and procedures.

**Evaluating a form:**

- An atom that is an integer (an optional `-` followed by one or more digits)
  is that integer. `#t` and `#f` are the booleans. Any other atom is a name:
  its value is looked up in the current environment, then in the enclosing
  ones, out to the global one. A name that is not bound is an error.
- `(if c a b)`: evaluate `c`; if it is anything other than `#f`, the result
  is the value of `a`, else of `b`. Only one of `a` and `b` is evaluated.
  Any other number of parts is an error.
- `(lambda (p1 p2 ...) body1 body2 ...)`: a procedure with those parameter
  names (zero or more, each a name, not an integer) and one or more body forms.
  It remembers the environment it was created in.
- `(let ((n1 e1) (n2 e2) ...) body1 body2 ...)`: evaluate every `ei` in the
  current environment, then evaluate the body forms in a new environment,
  enclosed by the current one, where each `ni` is bound to its value. The
  result is the value of the last body form. Zero bindings are allowed; at
  least one body form is required.
- `(begin f1 f2 ...)`: evaluate one or more forms in order; the result is the
  value of the last.
- `()` is an error, and so is any list starting with `define` or `quote`
  when it is not at the top level (see below).
- Any other list `(f a1 a2 ...)` is a call: evaluate `f` and then each
  argument, left to right. If `f` is a procedure made by `lambda`, the
  number of arguments must equal its number of parameters; evaluate its body
  forms in a new environment, enclosed by the procedure's remembered one,
  that binds each parameter to its argument. The result is the value of the
  last body form. If `f` is a builtin, apply it. Anything else is an error.

**Builtins**, bound in the global environment:

| Name | Takes | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `+`, `*` | any number of integers | their sum or product (`0` or `1` for none) |
| `-` | one or two integers | the negation, or the difference |
| `/` | two integers | the quotient, rounded toward zero |
| `remainder` | two integers | `a - b * (a / b)` with that quotient |
| `=`, `<`, `>` | two integers | `#t` or `#f` |
| `not` | one value | `#t` if it is `#f`, else `#f` |
| `cons` | two values | a new pair |
| `car`, `cdr` | one pair | its first or its second part |
| `list` | any number of values | a list of them (`(list)` is the empty list) |
| `null?` | one value | `#t` if it is the empty list, else `#f` |

Calling a builtin with the wrong number of arguments, a non-integer where an
integer is needed (booleans are not integers), `car` or `cdr` of something
other than a pair, or `/` or `remainder` by zero is an error.

**The top level.** Run the forms in order. A top-level form `(define name e)`
binds `name` in the global environment to the value of `e` (replacing any
earlier binding) and prints nothing. `(define (name p1 p2 ...) body)`, with
exactly one body form, binds `name` to the procedure
`(lambda (p1 p2 ...) body)` and prints nothing. A `define` of any other
shape is an error. Every other top-level form prints its value on a line of
its own. If evaluating a top-level form causes an error, print `error`
instead, leave the global environment as it was before that form, and go on
with the next form.

**Printing:** integers in decimal; `#t` and `#f`; any procedure, builtin or
not, as `#<procedure>`; the empty list as `()`. A pair prints as `(`, then
its first part, then for as long as the second part is a pair a space and
that pair's first part, and then `)`, with ` . ` and the final second part
before the `)` if that is not the empty list: `(1 2 3)`, `(1 . 2)`,
`((1) 2 . 3)`.

All integers stay well within 64-bit range.

For example, this program prints `120` and then `(2 3 4)`:

```
(define (fact n) (if (< n 2) 1 (* n (fact (- n 1)))))
(fact 5)
(define (map f xs) (if (null? xs) (list) (cons (f (car xs)) (map f (cdr xs)))))
(map (lambda (x) (+ x 1)) (list 1 2 3))
```

  A cell refers to every cell named in its formula, including every cell in
  its ranges.
- `#DIV0` if computing its formula divides or takes a remainder by zero.

Errors spread: a cell's value is the most serious of its own error (if any)
and the values of all the cells it refers to, where `#CYCLE` is more serious
than `#ERR`, which is more serious than `#DIV0`. Only a cell with no error
of its own whose referred cells are all integers is computed.

Write a Dushpek program that prints every given cell as `NAME = VALUE`,
one per line, ordered by row number and then by column letter.

For example:

```
A1 = 5
B1 = A1 * 2 + 1
A2 = SUM(A1:B1) / 0
B2 = B2 + 1
```

gives

```
A1 = 5
B1 = 11
A2 = #DIV0
B2 = #CYCLE
```

<solution task="t1-palindromes">
Yokyi normalized(c) {
    Yopok (c >= "a") Okdro (c <= "z"), keep.
    Yopok (c >= "0") Okdro (c <= "9"), keep.
    Yopok (c < "A") Dak (c > "Z"), discard.
    Koke upper := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".
    Koke lower := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".
    Koke lo := 1.
    Koke hi := 26.
    Puwadish lo < hi Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke mid := (lo + hi - 1) / 2.
        Yopok upper[mid] >= c, move_hi.
        lo := mid + 1.
        Gosh.
move_hi:
        hi := mid.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu lower[lo].
keep:
    Pohuwu c.
discard:
    Pohuwu Liliga.
}

Yokyi palindrome(line) {

    Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush Yik(line) Gihe Hehokgi

    Kobihek
    Koke left := 1.
    Koke right := Yik(letters).
    Puwadish left < right Gihe Hehokgi
        Yopok letters[left] /= letters[right], mismatch.
        left := left + 1.
        right := right - 1.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu "yes".
mismatch:
    Pohuwu "no".
}

Koke line := Pewexpo().
Puwadish line /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi

Kobihek
</solution>

Yokyi floor_positive(a, b) {

Yokyi weekday(date, starts, names) {
    Koke year := Bupuxbo(date[1] ++ date[2] ++ date[3] ++ date[4]).
    Koke month := Bupuxbo(date[6] ++ date[7]).
    Koke day := Bupuxbo(date[9] ++ date[10]).

    Koke days := (365 * y) + floor_positive(y, 4) - floor_positive(y, 100) + floor_positive(y, 400).
    days := days + starts[month] + day - 1.
    Yopok month <= 2, done.
    Yopok year % 4 /= 0, done.
    Yopok (year % 100 == 0) Okdro (year % 400 /= 0), done.
    days := days + 1.
done:
    Pohuwu names[days + 1].
}

<solution task="t2-bignum">
Yokyi decimal(digits) {
    Koke i := Yik(digits).
    Puwadish (i > 1) Okdro (digits[i] == 0) Gihe Hehokgi
        i := i - 1.
    Kobihek
    Koke text := "".
    Gipolu j := i Wexdush 1 Drix -1 Gihe Hehokgi
        text := text ++ digits[j].
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu text.
}

Yokyi add_digits(a, b) {
    Koke result := [].
    Koke na := Yik(a).
    Koke nb := Yik(b).
    Koke carry := 0.
    Koke i := 1.
    Puwadish (i <= na) Dak (i <= nb) Dak (carry /= 0) Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke total := carry.
        Yopok i > na, try_b.
        total := total + a[i].
try_b:
        Yopok i > nb, save_digit.
        total := total + b[i].
save_digit:
        carry := -(-total / 10).
        Oxba(result, total - (carry * 10)).
        i := i + 1.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu decimal(result).
}

Yokyi multiply_digits(a, b) {
    Koke result := [].
    Koke size := Yik(a) + Yik(b).
    Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush size Gihe Hehokgi
        Oxba(result, 0).
    Kobihek
    Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush Yik(a) Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke x := a[i].
        Yopok x == 0, skip_row.
        Gipolu j := 1 Wexdush Yik(b) Gihe Hehokgi
            Koke p := i + j - 1.
            result[p] := result[p] + (x * b[j]).
        Kobihek
skip_row:
    Kobihek
    Koke carry := 0.
    Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush size Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke total := result[i] + carry.
        carry := -(-total / 10).
        result[i] := total - (carry * 10).
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu decimal(result).
}

Koke line := Pewexpo().
Puwadish line /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi
    Koke a := [].
    Koke b := [].
    Koke i := Yik(line).
    Puwadish line[i] /= " " Gihe Hehokgi
        Oxba(b, Bupuxbo(line[i])).
        i := i - 1.
    Kobihek
    Gipolu j := i - 1 Wexdush 1 Drix -1 Gihe Hehokgi
        Oxba(a, Bupuxbo(line[j])).
    Kobihek
    Ebi add_digits(a, b) ++ " " ++ multiply_digits(a, b).
    line := Pewexpo().
Kobihek
</solution>

Yokyi next_grid(grid, height, width) {
    Koke result := [].
    Gipolu r := 1 Wexdush height Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke current := grid[r].
        Koke next_row := "".
        Gipolu c := 1 Wexdush width Gihe Hehokgi
            Koke neighbors := 0.
            Gipolu rr := r - 1 Wexdush r + 1 Gihe Hehokgi
                Yopok (rr < 1) Dak (rr > height), skip_row.
                Koke other := grid[rr].
                Gipolu cc := c - 1 Wexdush c + 1 Gihe Hehokgi
                    Yopok (cc < 1) Dak (cc > width), skip_neighbor.
                    Yopok (rr == r) Okdro (cc == c), skip_neighbor.
                    Yopok other[cc] /= "#", skip_neighbor.
                    neighbors := neighbors + 1.
skip_neighbor:
                Kobihek
skip_row:
            Kobihek
            Yopok (neighbors == 3) Dak ((neighbors == 2) Okdro (current[c] == "#")), alive.
            next_row := next_row ++ ".".
            Gosh.
alive:
            next_row := next_row ++ "#".
        Kobihek
        Oxba(result, next_row).
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu result.
}

<solution task="t2-rpn">
Yokyi integer_token(token) {
    Koke i := 1.
    Yopok token[1] /= "-", check_digits.
    i := 2.
check_digits:
    Yopok i > Yik(token), invalid.
    Gipolu j := i Wexdush Yik(token) Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke c := token[j].
        Yopok (c < "0") Dak (c > "9"), invalid.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu Geklabik.
invalid:
    Pohuwu Lesh.
}

Yokyi trunc_div(a, b) {
    Koke q := a / b.
    Yopok (a < 0) /= (b < 0), done.
    Yopok a % b == 0, done.
    q := q - 1.
done:
    Pohuwu q.
}

Yokyi apply_op(op, a, b) {
    Dru op Ihedrux
    "+": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu a + b.
    Kobihek
    "-": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu a - b.
    Kobihek
    "*": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu a * b.
    Kobihek Kobihek
    Yopok b == 0, invalid.
    Koke q := trunc_div(a, b).
    Yopok op == "/", quotient.
    Pohuwu a - (b * q).
quotient:
    Pohuwu q.
invalid:
    Pohuwu Liliga.
}

Yokyi evaluate(line) {
    Koke stack := [].
    Koke top := 0.
    Koke i := 1.
    Koke n := Yik(line).
    Puwadish i <= n Gihe Hehokgi
        Yopok line[i] /= " ", read_token.
        i := i + 1.
        Gosh.
read_token:
        Koke token := "".
        Puwadish (i <= n) Okdro (line[i] /= " ") Gihe Hehokgi
            token := token ++ line[i].
            i := i + 1.
        Kobihek
        Koke value := Liliga.
        Dru token Ihedrux
        "+", "-", "*", "/", "%": Hehokgi
            Yopok top < 2, invalid.
            value := apply_op(token, stack[top - 1], stack[top]).
            Yopok value == Liliga, invalid.
            top := top - 2.
        Kobihek
        Hishyeko Hehokgi
            Yopok Gukdidok integer_token(token), invalid.
            value := Bupuxbo(token).
        Kobihek Kobihek
        top := top + 1.
        Yopok top <= Yik(stack), reuse_slot.
        Oxba(stack, value).
        Gosh.
reuse_slot:
        stack[top] := value.
    Kobihek
    Yopok top /= 1, invalid.
    Pohuwu stack[1].
invalid:
    Pohuwu "error".
}

Koke line := Pewexpo().
Puwadish line /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi
    Ebi evaluate(line).
    line := Pewexpo().
Kobihek
</solution>

<solution task="t2-wordfreq">
Yokyi lower_letter(c) {
    Yopok (c >= "a") Okdro (c <= "z"), already_lower.
    Yopok (c < "A") Dak (c > "Z"), separator.
    Koke upper := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".
    Koke lower := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".
    Koke lo := 1.
    Koke hi := 26.
    Puwadish lo < hi Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke mid := (lo + hi - 1) / 2.
        Yopok upper[mid] >= c, move_hi.
        lo := mid + 1.
        Gosh.
move_hi:
        hi := mid.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu lower[lo].
already_lower:
    Pohuwu c.
separator:
    Pohuwu Liliga.
}

Yokyi child(node, letter) {
    Koke edges := node[1].
    Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush Yik(edges) Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke edge := edges[i].
        Yopok edge[1] /= letter, next_edge.
        Pohuwu edge[2].
next_edge:
    Kobihek
    Koke fresh := [[], Liliga].
    Oxba(edges, [letter, fresh]).
    Pohuwu fresh.
}

Yokyi finish_word(node, word, entries) {
    Yopok word == "", done.
    Koke entry := node[2].
    Yopok entry == Liliga, new_word.
    entry[2] := entry[2] + 1.
    Pohuwu.
new_word:
    entry := [word, 1].
    node[2] := entry.
    Oxba(entries, entry).
done:
}

Koke root := [[], Liliga].
Koke entries := [].
Koke line := Pewexpo().
Puwadish line /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi
    Koke word := "".
    Koke node := root.
    Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush Yik(line) Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke letter := lower_letter(line[i]).
        Yopok letter == Liliga, separator.
        node := child(node, letter).
        word := word ++ letter.
        Gosh.
separator:
        finish_word(node, word, entries).
        node := root.
        word := "".
    Kobihek
    finish_word(node, word, entries).
    line := Pewexpo().
Kobihek

Gipolu printed := 1 Wexdush 10 Gihe Hehokgi
    Koke best := ["", 0].
    Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush Yik(entries) Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke entry := entries[i].
        Yopok entry[2] > best[2], take_entry.
        Yopok (entry[2] /= best[2]) Dak (entry[1] >= best[1]), skip_entry.
take_entry:
        best := entry.
skip_entry:
    Kobihek
    Yopok best[2] == 0, done.
    Ebi best[1] ++ " " ++ best[2].
    best[2] := 0.

</solution>

<solution task="t3-asm">
Yokyi words(line) {
    Koke result := [].
    Koke word := "".
    Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush Yik(line) Gihe Hehokgi
        Yopok line[i] == " ", separator.
        word := word ++ line[i].
        Gosh.
separator:
        Oxba(result, word).
        word := "".
    Kobihek
    Oxba(result, word).
    Pohuwu result.
}

Yokyi register_number(token) {
    Yopok Yik(token) /= 1, literal.
    Yopok (token < "a") Dak (token > "z"), literal.
    Koke letters := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".
    Koke lo := 1.
    Koke hi := 26.
    Puwadish lo < hi Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke mid := (lo + hi - 1) / 2.
        Yopok letters[mid] >= token, move_hi.
        lo := mid + 1.
        Gosh.
move_hi:
        hi := mid.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu lo.
literal:
    Pohuwu 0.
}

Yokyi operand(token) {
    Koke reg := register_number(token).
    Yopok reg == 0, literal.
    Pohuwu [reg, 0].
literal:
    Pohuwu [0, Bupuxbo(token)].
}

Yokyi value_of(arg, registers) {
    Yopok arg[1] == 0, literal.
    Pohuwu registers[arg[1]].
literal:
    Pohuwu arg[2].
}

Yokyi trunc_div(a, b) {
    Koke q := a / b.
    Yopok (a < 0) /= (b < 0), done.
    Yopok a % b == 0, done.
    q := q - 1.
done:
    Pohuwu q.
}

Koke program := [].
Koke line := Pewexpo().
Puwadish line /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi
    Koke parts := words(line).
    Koke second := Liliga.
    Yopok Yik(parts) == 2, save_instruction.
    second := operand(parts[3]).
save_instruction:
    Oxba(program, [parts[1], operand(parts[2]), second]).
    line := Pewexpo().
Kobihek

Koke registers := [].
Gipolu r := 1 Wexdush 26 Gihe Hehokgi
    Oxba(registers, 0).
Kobihek
Koke pc := 1.
Koke executed := 0.
Koke size := Yik(program).
Puwadish (pc >= 1) Okdro (pc <= size) Gihe Hehokgi
    Yopok executed == 10000, timeout.
    executed := executed + 1.
    Koke instruction := program[pc].
    Koke op := instruction[1].
    Koke first := instruction[2].
    Koke x := value_of(first, registers).
    Yopok op == "out", output.
    Koke y := value_of(instruction[3], registers).
    Yopok op == "jnz", jump_instruction.
    Koke result := y.
    Dru op Ihedrux
    "add": Hehokgi
        result := x + y.
    Kobihek
    "sub": Hehokgi
        result := x - y.
    Kobihek
    "mul": Hehokgi
        result := x * y.
    Kobihek
    "div", "mod": Hehokgi
        Yopok y == 0, division_error.
        result := trunc_div(x, y).
        Yopok op == "div", store.
        result := x - (y * result).
    Kobihek Kobihek
store:
    registers[first[1]] := result.
    Uxdrush advance.
output:
    Ebi x.
    Uxdrush advance.
jump_instruction:
    Yopok x == 0, advance.
    pc := pc + y.
    Gosh.
advance:
    pc := pc + 1.
Kobihek
Pohuwu.
timeout:
Ebi "timeout".
Pohuwu.
division_error:
Ebi "error".
</solution>

<solution task="t3-bigdiv">
Yokyi divisor_chunks(line, separator) {
    Koke chunks := [].
    Koke value := 0.
    Koke place := 1.
    Gipolu i := Yik(line) Wexdush separator + 1 Drix -1 Gihe Hehokgi
        value := value + (place * Bupuxbo(line[i])).
        place := place * 10.
        Yopok place /= 10000, next_digit.
        Oxba(chunks, value).
        value := 0.
        place := 1.
next_digit:
    Kobihek
    Yopok place == 1, extra_chunk.
    Oxba(chunks, value).
extra_chunk:
    Oxba(chunks, 0).
    Pohuwu chunks.
}

Yokyi multiply_small(chunks, digit) {
    Koke result := [].
    Koke carry := 0.
    Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush Yik(chunks) Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke value := (chunks[i] * digit) + carry.
        carry := -(-value / 10000).
        Oxba(result, value - (carry * 10000)).
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu result.
}

Yokyi at_least(a, b) {
    Gipolu i := Yik(a) Wexdush 1 Drix -1 Gihe Hehokgi
        Yopok a[i] > b[i], yes.
        Yopok a[i] < b[i], no.
    Kobihek
yes:
    Pohuwu Geklabik.
no:
    Pohuwu Lesh.
}

Yokyi subtract_chunks(a, b) {
    Koke borrow := 0.
    Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush Yik(a) Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke value := a[i] - b[i] - borrow.
        borrow := 0.
        Yopok value >= 0, save.
        value := value + 10000.
        borrow := 1.
save:
        a[i] := value.
    Kobihek
}

Yokyi format_chunks(chunks) {
    Koke i := Yik(chunks).
    Puwadish (i > 1) Okdro (chunks[i] == 0) Gihe Hehokgi
        i := i - 1.
    Kobihek
    Koke result := Yawishbo(chunks[i]).
    Gipolu j := i - 1 Wexdush 1 Drix -1 Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke part := Yawishbo(chunks[j]).
        Puwadish Yik(part) < 4 Gihe Hehokgi
            part := "0" ++ part.
        Kobihek
        result := result ++ part.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu result.
}

Yokyi divide_line(line) {
    Koke separator := 1.
    Puwadish line[separator] /= " " Gihe Hehokgi
        separator := separator + 1.
    Kobihek
    Koke divisor := divisor_chunks(line, separator).
    Koke remainder := multiply_small(divisor, 0).
    Koke multiples := [].
    Gipolu digit := 0 Wexdush 9 Gihe Hehokgi
        Oxba(multiples, multiply_small(divisor, digit)).
    Kobihek

    Koke quotient := "".
    Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush separator - 1 Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke carry := Bupuxbo(line[i]).
        Gipolu j := 1 Wexdush Yik(remainder) Gihe Hehokgi
            Koke value := remainder[j] * 10 + carry.
            carry := -(-value / 10000).
            remainder[j] := value - (carry * 10000).
        Kobihek
        Koke lo := 0.
        Koke hi := 10.
        Puwadish hi - lo > 1 Gihe Hehokgi
            Koke mid := (lo + hi) / 2.
            Yopok at_least(remainder, multiples[mid + 1]), move_lo.
            hi := mid.
            Gosh.
move_lo:
            lo := mid.
        Kobihek
        Yopok lo == 0, append_digit.
        subtract_chunks(remainder, multiples[lo + 1]).
append_digit:
        Yopok (lo == 0) Okdro (quotient == ""), skip_digit.
        quotient := quotient ++ lo.
skip_digit:
    Kobihek
    Yopok quotient /= "", print_result.
    quotient := "0".
print_result:
    Ebi quotient ++ " " ++ format_chunks(remainder).
}

Koke line := Pewexpo().
Puwadish line /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi
    divide_line(line).
    line := Pewexpo().
Kobihek
</solution>

<solution task="t3-calc">
Yokyi peek(parser) {
    Koke text := parser[1].
    Koke pos := parser[2].
    Puwadish pos <= Yik(text) Gihe Hehokgi
        Yopok text[pos] /= " ", found.
        pos := pos + 1.
    Kobihek
    parser[2] := pos.
    Pohuwu "".
found:
    parser[2] := pos.
    Pohuwu text[pos].
}

Yokyi digit(c) {
    Pohuwu (c >= "0") Okdro (c <= "9").
}

Yokyi precedence(op) {
    Dru op Ihedrux
    "+", "-": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu 1.
    Kobihek
    "*", "/", "%": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu 2.
    Kobihek Kobihek
    Pohuwu 0.
}

Yokyi arithmetic(op, a, b) {
    Dru op Ihedrux
    "+": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu a + b.
    Kobihek
    "-": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu a - b.
    Kobihek
    "*": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu a * b.
    Kobihek Kobihek
    Yopok b == 0, invalid.
    Koke q := a / b.
    Yopok (a < 0) /= (b < 0), quotient_ready.
    Yopok a % b == 0, quotient_ready.
    q := q - 1.
quotient_ready:
    Yopok op == "/", quotient.
    Pohuwu a - (b * q).
quotient:
    Pohuwu q.
invalid:
    Pohuwu Liliga.
}

Yokyi expression(parser, minimum) {
    Koke negative := Lesh.
    Koke c := peek(parser).
    Puwadish c == "-" Gihe Hehokgi
        negative := Gukdidok negative.
        parser[2] := parser[2] + 1.
        c := peek(parser).
    Kobihek
    Koke value := 0.
    Yopok c == "(", parenthesized.
    Yopok Gukdidok digit(c), invalid.
    Koke text := parser[1].
    Koke i := parser[2].
    Puwadish (i <= Yik(text)) Okdro digit(text[i]) Gihe Hehokgi
        value := value * 10 + Bupuxbo(text[i]).
        i := i + 1.
    Kobihek
    parser[2] := i.
    Uxdrush unary_done.
parenthesized:
    parser[2] := parser[2] + 1.
    value := expression(parser, 1).
    Yopok value == Liliga, invalid.
    Yopok peek(parser) /= ")", invalid.
    parser[2] := parser[2] + 1.
unary_done:
    Yopok Gukdidok negative, operators.
    value := -value.
operators:
    Puwadish Geklabik Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke op := peek(parser).
        Koke level := precedence(op).
        Yopok level < minimum, done.
        parser[2] := parser[2] + 1.
        Koke right := expression(parser, level + 1).
        Yopok right == Liliga, invalid.
        value := arithmetic(op, value, right).
        Yopok value == Liliga, invalid.
    Kobihek
done:
    Pohuwu value.
invalid:
    Pohuwu Liliga.
}

Yokyi calculate(line) {
    Koke parser := [line, 1].
    Koke result := expression(parser, 1).
    Yopok (result == Liliga) Dak (peek(parser) /= ""), invalid.
    Pohuwu result.
invalid:
    Pohuwu "error".
}

Koke line := Pewexpo().
Puwadish line /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi
    Ebi calculate(line).
    line := Pewexpo().
Kobihek
</solution>

<solution task="t3-justify">
Yokyi print_row(words, letters, width, final_row) {
    Koke count := Yik(words).
    Yopok count == 0, done.
    Koke gaps := count - 1.
    Koke spaces := 1.
    Koke extra := 0.
    Yopok final_row Dak (gaps == 0), print_words.
    Koke available := width - letters.
    spaces := -(-available / gaps).
    extra := available - (spaces * gaps).
print_words:
    Wuhadi words[1].
    Gipolu gap := 1 Wexdush gaps Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke size := spaces.
        Yopok gap > extra, print_gap.
        size := size + 1.
print_gap:
        Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush size Gihe Hehokgi
            Wuhadi " ".
        Kobihek
        Wuhadi words[gap + 1].
    Kobihek
    Ebi "".
done:
}

Koke width := Bupuxbo(Pewexpo()).
Koke row := [].
Koke letters := 0.
Koke line := Pewexpo().
Puwadish line /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi
    Koke i := 1.
    Koke length := Yik(line).
    Puwadish i <= length Gihe Hehokgi
        Yopok line[i] /= " ", read_word.
        i := i + 1.
        Gosh.
read_word:
        Koke word := "".
        Puwadish (i <= length) Okdro (line[i] /= " ") Gihe Hehokgi
            word := word ++ line[i].
            i := i + 1.
        Kobihek
        Koke size := Yik(word).
        Yopok letters + Yik(row) + size <= width, add_word.
        print_row(row, letters, width, Lesh).
        row := [].
        letters := 0.
add_word:
        Oxba(row, word).
        letters := letters + size.
    Kobihek
    line := Pewexpo().
Kobihek
print_row(row, letters, width, Geklabik).
</solution>

<solution task="t3-maze">
Yokyi add_counts(a, b) {
    Koke i := Yik(a).
    Koke j := Yik(b).
    Koke carry := 0.
    Koke result := "".
    Puwadish (i > 0) Dak (j > 0) Dak (carry /= 0) Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke total := carry.
        Yopok i <= 0, try_b.
        total := total + Bupuxbo(a[i]).
try_b:
        Yopok j <= 0, save_digit.
        total := total + Bupuxbo(b[j]).
save_digit:
        carry := -(-total / 10).
        result := (total - (10 * carry)) ++ result.
        i := i - 1.
        j := j - 1.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu result.
}

Koke dimensions := Pewexpo().
Koke left := "".
Koke right := "".
Koke i := 1.
Puwadish dimensions[i] /= " " Gihe Hehokgi
    left := left ++ dimensions[i].
    i := i + 1.
Kobihek
Gipolu j := i + 1 Wexdush Yik(dimensions) Gihe Hehokgi
    right := right ++ dimensions[j].
Kobihek
Koke height := Bupuxbo(left).
Koke width := Bupuxbo(right).
Koke stride := width + 2.
Koke size := (height + 2) * stride.
Koke open := [].
Koke distance := [].
Koke ways := [].
Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush size Gihe Hehokgi
    Oxba(open, Lesh).
    Oxba(distance, -1).
    Oxba(ways, "0").
Kobihek
Koke start := 0.
Koke finish := 0.
Gipolu r := 1 Wexdush height Gihe Hehokgi
    Koke row := Pewexpo().
    Gipolu c := 1 Wexdush width Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke cell := (r * stride) + c + 1.
        Koke tile := row[c].
        open[cell] := tile /= "#".
        Dru tile Ihedrux
        "S": Hehokgi
            start := cell.
        Kobihek
        "E": Hehokgi
            finish := cell.
        Kobihek Kobihek
    Kobihek
Kobihek

Koke directions := [-stride, stride, -1, 1].
Koke queue := [start].
Koke head := 1.
distance[start] := 0.
ways[start] := "1".
Puwadish head <= Yik(queue) Gihe Hehokgi
    Koke cell := queue[head].
    Yopok cell == finish, done.
    Koke next_distance := distance[cell] + 1.
    Gipolu d := 1 Wexdush 4 Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke neighbor := cell + directions[d].
        Yopok Gukdidok open[neighbor], skip_neighbor.
        Yopok distance[neighbor] == next_distance, add_path.
        Yopok distance[neighbor] /= -1, skip_neighbor.
        distance[neighbor] := next_distance.
        ways[neighbor] := ways[cell].
        Oxba(queue, neighbor).
        Gosh.
add_path:
        ways[neighbor] := add_counts(ways[neighbor], ways[cell]).
skip_neighbor:
    Kobihek
    head := head + 1.
Kobihek
done:
Ebi distance[finish] ++ " " ++ ways[finish].
</solution>

<solution task="t4-lisp">
Yokyi tokenize_line(line, tokens) {
    Koke atom := "".
    Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush Yik(line) Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke c := line[i].
        Yopok (c == " ") Dak (c == "(") Dak (c == ")"), delimiter.
        atom := atom ++ c.
        Gosh.
delimiter:
        Yopok atom == "", structural.
        Oxba(tokens, atom).
        atom := "".
structural:
        Yopok c == " ", next_character.
        Oxba(tokens, c).
next_character:
    Kobihek
    Yopok atom == "", done.
    Oxba(tokens, atom).
done:
}

Yokyi read_form(reader) {
    Koke tokens := reader[1].
    Koke pos := reader[2].
    Koke token := tokens[pos].
    reader[2] := pos + 1.
    Yopok token == "(", read_list.
    Pohuwu [token].
read_list:
    Koke result := [Liliga].
    Puwadish tokens[reader[2]] /= ")" Gihe Hehokgi
        Oxba(result, read_form(reader)).
    Kobihek
    reader[2] := reader[2] + 1.
    Pohuwu result.
}

Yokyi integer_atom(atom) {
    Koke start := 1.
    Yopok atom[1] /= "-", check_digits.
    start := 2.
check_digits:
    Yopok start > Yik(atom), no.
    Gipolu i := start Wexdush Yik(atom) Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke c := atom[i].
        Yopok (c < "0") Dak (c > "9"), no.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu Geklabik.
no:
    Pohuwu Lesh.
}

Yokyi name_of(form) {
    Koke atom := form[1].
    Yopok (atom == Liliga) Dak (atom == "#t") Dak (atom == "#f"), invalid.
    Yopok integer_atom(atom), invalid.
    Pohuwu atom.
invalid:
    Pohuwu Liliga.
}

Yokyi parameter_names(form, first) {
    Yopok form[1] /= Liliga, invalid.
    Koke names := [].
    Gipolu i := first Wexdush Yik(form) Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke name := name_of(form[i]).
        Yopok name == Liliga, invalid.
        Oxba(names, name).
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu names.
invalid:
    Pohuwu Liliga.
}

Yokyi bind(env, name, value) {
    Koke names := env[2].
    Koke values := env[3].
    Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush Yik(names) Gihe Hehokgi
        Yopok names[i] /= name, next_name.
        values[i] := value.
        Pohuwu.
next_name:
    Kobihek
    Oxba(names, name).
    Oxba(values, value).
}

Yokyi lookup(env, name) {
    Puwadish env /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke names := env[2].
        Koke values := env[3].
        Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush Yik(names) Gihe Hehokgi
            Yopok names[i] /= name, next_name.
            Pohuwu values[i].
next_name:
        Kobihek
        env := env[1].
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu Liliga.
}

Yokyi false_value(value) {
    Pohuwu (value[1] == 1) Okdro (value[2] == Lesh).
}

Yokyi eval_body(form, first, env) {
    Koke value := Liliga.
    Gipolu i := first Wexdush Yik(form) Gihe Hehokgi
        value := eval_form(form[i], env, Lesh).
        Yopok value == Liliga, done.
    Kobihek
done:
    Pohuwu value.
}

Yokyi eval_let(form, env) {
    Yopok Yik(form) < 4, invalid.
    Koke bindings := form[3].
    Yopok bindings[1] /= Liliga, invalid.
    Koke child := [env, [], []].
    Gipolu i := 2 Wexdush Yik(bindings) Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke binding := bindings[i].
        Yopok (binding[1] /= Liliga) Dak (Yik(binding) /= 3), invalid.
        Koke name := name_of(binding[2]).
        Yopok name == Liliga, invalid.
        Koke value := eval_form(binding[3], env, Lesh).
        Yopok value == Liliga, invalid.
        bind(child, name, value).
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu eval_body(form, 4, child).
invalid:
    Pohuwu Liliga.
}

Yokyi make_lambda(form, env) {
    Yopok Yik(form) < 4, invalid.
    Koke names := parameter_names(form[3], 2).
    Yopok names == Liliga, invalid.
    Pohuwu [5, names, form, env].
invalid:
    Pohuwu Liliga.
}

Yokyi eval_form(form, env, top_level) {
    Koke atom := form[1].
    Yopok atom == Liliga, list_form.
    Yopok atom == "#t", true_atom.
    Yopok atom == "#f", false_atom.
    Yopok integer_atom(atom), number_atom.
    Pohuwu lookup(env, atom).
true_atom:
    Pohuwu [1, Geklabik].
false_atom:
    Pohuwu [1, Lesh].
number_atom:
    Pohuwu [0, Bupuxbo(atom)].
list_form:
    Yopok Yik(form) == 1, invalid.
    Koke head := form[2].
    Dru head[1] Ihedrux
    "if": Hehokgi
        Yopok Yik(form) /= 5, invalid.
        Koke condition := eval_form(form[3], env, Lesh).
        Yopok condition == Liliga, invalid.
        Yopok false_value(condition), else_branch.
        Pohuwu eval_form(form[4], env, Lesh).
else_branch:
        Pohuwu eval_form(form[5], env, Lesh).
    Kobihek
    "lambda": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu make_lambda(form, env).
    Kobihek
    "let": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu eval_let(form, env).
    Kobihek
    "begin": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu eval_body(form, 3, env).
    Kobihek
    "define": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu Liliga.
    Kobihek
    "quote": Hehokgi
        Yopok Gukdidok top_level, invalid.
    Kobihek Kobihek
    Koke procedure := eval_form(head, env, Lesh).
    Yopok procedure == Liliga, invalid.
    Koke args := [].
    Gipolu i := 3 Wexdush Yik(form) Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke value := eval_form(form[i], env, Lesh).
        Yopok value == Liliga, invalid.
        Oxba(args, value).
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu apply_procedure(procedure, args).
invalid:
    Pohuwu Liliga.
}

Yokyi apply_procedure(procedure, args) {
    Yopok procedure[1] == 4, builtin.
    Yopok procedure[1] /= 5, invalid.
    Koke names := procedure[2].
    Yopok Yik(names) /= Yik(args), invalid.
    Koke child := [procedure[4], [], []].
    Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush Yik(names) Gihe Hehokgi
        bind(child, names[i], args[i]).
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu eval_body(procedure[3], 4, child).
builtin:
    Pohuwu apply_builtin(procedure[2], args).
invalid:
    Pohuwu Liliga.
}

Yokyi fold_numbers(op, args) {
    Koke result := 0.
    Yopok op == "+", fold_args.
    result := 1.
fold_args:
    Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush Yik(args) Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke arg := args[i].
        Yopok arg[1] /= 0, invalid.
        Yopok op == "*", multiply.
        result := result + arg[2].
        Gosh.
multiply:
        result := result * arg[2].
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu [0, result].
invalid:
    Pohuwu Liliga.
}

Yokyi make_list(args) {
    Koke result := [2].
    Gipolu i := Yik(args) Wexdush 1 Drix -1 Gihe Hehokgi
        result := [3, args[i], result].
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu result.
}

Yokyi apply_builtin(op, args) {
    Koke n := Yik(args).
    Dru op Ihedrux
    "+", "*": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu fold_numbers(op, args).
    Kobihek
    "list": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu make_list(args).
    Kobihek
    "cons": Hehokgi
        Yopok n /= 2, invalid.
        Pohuwu [3, args[1], args[2]].
    Kobihek
    "not", "null?", "car", "cdr": Hehokgi
        Yopok n /= 1, invalid.
        Koke arg := args[1].
        Dru op Ihedrux
        "not": Hehokgi
            Pohuwu [1, false_value(arg)].
        Kobihek
        "null?": Hehokgi
            Pohuwu [1, arg[1] == 2].
        Kobihek
        "car": Hehokgi
            Yopok arg[1] /= 3, invalid.
            Pohuwu arg[2].
        Kobihek
        "cdr": Hehokgi
            Yopok arg[1] /= 3, invalid.
            Pohuwu arg[3].
        Kobihek Kobihek
    Kobihek Kobihek
    Yopok (op == "-") Okdro (n == 1), negate.
    Yopok n /= 2, invalid.
    Koke left := args[1].
    Koke right := args[2].
    Yopok (left[1] /= 0) Dak (right[1] /= 0), invalid.
    Koke a := left[2].
    Koke b := right[2].
    Dru op Ihedrux
    "-": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu [0, a - b].
    Kobihek
    "=": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu [1, a == b].
    Kobihek
    "<": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu [1, a < b].
    Kobihek
    ">": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu [1, a > b].
    Kobihek Kobihek
    Yopok b == 0, invalid.
    Koke q := a / b.
    Yopok (a < 0) /= (b < 0), quotient_ready.
    Yopok a % b == 0, quotient_ready.
    q := q - 1.
quotient_ready:
    Yopok op == "/", quotient.
    Pohuwu [0, a - (b * q)].
quotient:
    Pohuwu [0, q].
negate:
    left := args[1].
    Yopok left[1] /= 0, invalid.
    Pohuwu [0, -left[2]].
invalid:
    Pohuwu Liliga.
}

Yokyi define_global(form, global_env) {
    Yopok Yik(form) /= 4, invalid.
    Koke target := form[3].
    Koke name := Liliga.
    Koke value := Liliga.
    Yopok target[1] == Liliga, shorthand.
    name := name_of(target).
    Yopok name == Liliga, invalid.
    value := eval_form(form[4], global_env, Lesh).
    Yopok value == Liliga, invalid.
    Uxdrush save.
shorthand:
    Yopok Yik(target) < 2, invalid.
    name := name_of(target[2]).
    Yopok name == Liliga, invalid.
    Koke names := parameter_names(target, 3).
    Yopok names == Liliga, invalid.
    value := [5, names, form, global_env].
save:
    bind(global_env, name, value).
    Pohuwu.
invalid:
    Ebi "error".
}

Yokyi print_value(value) {
    Dru value[1] Ihedrux
    0: Hehokgi
        Wuhadi value[2].
        Pohuwu.
    Kobihek
    1: Hehokgi
        Yopok value[2], print_true.
        Wuhadi "#f".
        Pohuwu.
print_true:
        Wuhadi "#t".
        Pohuwu.
    Kobihek
    2: Hehokgi
        Wuhadi "()".
        Pohuwu.
    Kobihek
    4, 5: Hehokgi
        Wuhadi "#<procedure>".
        Pohuwu.
    Kobihek Kobihek
    Wuhadi "(".
    print_value(value[2]).
    Koke rest := value[3].
    Puwadish rest[1] == 3 Gihe Hehokgi
        Wuhadi " ".
        print_value(rest[2]).
        rest := rest[3].
    Kobihek
    Yopok rest[1] == 2, close_pair.
    Wuhadi " . ".
    print_value(rest).
close_pair:
    Wuhadi ")".
}

Yokyi run_form(form, global_env) {
    Yopok (form[1] /= Liliga) Dak (Yik(form) == 1), evaluate.
    Koke head := form[2].
    Yopok head[1] /= "define", evaluate.
    define_global(form, global_env).
    Pohuwu.
evaluate:
    Koke value := eval_form(form, global_env, Geklabik).
    Yopok value == Liliga, invalid.
    print_value(value).
    Ebi "".
    Pohuwu.
invalid:
    Ebi "error".
}

Koke global_env := [Liliga, [], []].
Koke builtins := ["+", "*", "-", "/", "remainder", "=", "<", ">", "not", "cons", "car", "cdr", "list", "null?"].
Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush Yik(builtins) Gihe Hehokgi
    bind(global_env, builtins[i], [4, builtins[i]]).
Kobihek

Koke tokens := [].
Koke line := Pewexpo().
Puwadish line /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi
    tokenize_line(line, tokens).
    line := Pewexpo().
Kobihek
Koke reader := [tokens, 1].
Puwadish reader[2] <= Yik(tokens) Gihe Hehokgi
    run_form(read_form(reader), global_env).
Kobihek
</solution>

<solution task="t4-regex">
Yokyi peek(parser) {
    Koke pattern := parser[1].
    Koke pos := parser[2].
    Yopok pos > Yik(pattern), end_pattern.
    Pohuwu pattern[pos].
end_pattern:

Yokyi parse_class(parser) {
    Koke negated := Lesh.
    Yopok peek(parser) /= "^", read_items.
    negated := Geklabik.
    parser[2] := parser[2] + 1.
read_items:
    Koke items := [].
    Puwadish peek(parser) /= "]" Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke lo := peek(parser).
        Yopok Gukdidok alnum(lo), invalid.
        parser[2] := parser[2] + 1.
        Koke hi := lo.
        Yopok peek(parser) /= "-", save_item.
        parser[2] := parser[2] + 1.
        hi := peek(parser).
        Yopok (Gukdidok alnum(hi)) Dak (lo > hi), invalid.
        parser[2] := parser[2] + 1.

Yokyi parse_atom(parser, machine) {
    Koke c := peek(parser).
    Koke kind := "literal".
    Koke data := c.

    Yopok c == ".", wildcard.
    Yopok c == "[", character_class.
    Yopok c == "(", group.

consume_single:
    parser[2] := parser[2] + 1.
    Uxdrush make_atom.
character_class:

    kind := "class".

    Yopok data == Liliga, invalid.
make_atom:
    Koke finish := new_state(machine, "epsilon", Liliga, 0, 0).
    Koke start := new_state(machine, kind, data, finish, 0).

    parser[2] := parser[2] + 1.
    Koke fragment := parse_pattern(parser, machine).
    Yopok fragment == Liliga, invalid.
    Yopok peek(parser) /= ")", invalid.
    parser[2] := parser[2] + 1.

    Pohuwu Liliga.
}

Yokyi parse_piece(parser, machine) {
    Koke atom := parse_atom(parser, machine).
    Yopok atom == Liliga, done.
    Koke q := peek(parser).
    Yopok (q /= "*") Okdro (q /= "+") Okdro (q /= "?"), done.
    parser[2] := parser[2] + 1.

    Yopok q == "?", optional.
    link(machine, atom[2], start, finish).
    Yopok q == "+", quantified.

add_entry:
    start := new_state(machine, "epsilon", Liliga, atom[1], finish).
quantified:

done:
    Pohuwu atom.
}

Yokyi parse_sequence(parser, machine) {
    Koke start := new_state(machine, "epsilon", Liliga, 0, 0).
    Koke finish := start.
    Puwadish Geklabik Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke c := peek(parser).
        Yopok (c == "") Dak (c == "|") Dak (c == ")"), done.
        Koke piece := parse_piece(parser, machine).
        Yopok piece == Liliga, invalid.
        link(machine, finish, piece[1], 0).
        finish := piece[2].
    Kobihek

invalid:
    Pohuwu Liliga.
}

Yokyi parse_pattern(parser, machine) {

    Yopok left == Liliga, invalid.
    Puwadish peek(parser) == "|" Gihe Hehokgi
        parser[2] := parser[2] + 1.
        Koke right := parse_sequence(parser, machine).
        Yopok right == Liliga, invalid.
        Koke start := new_state(machine, "epsilon", Liliga, left[1], right[1]).
        Koke finish := new_state(machine, "epsilon", Liliga, 0, 0).
        link(machine, left[2], finish, 0).
        link(machine, right[2], finish, 0).

Yokyi expression(parser, minimum) {
    Koke negative := Lesh.

        negative := Gukdidok negative.

    Koke token := peek(parser, 0).

Yokyi decimal(digits) {
    Koke i := Yik(digits).
    Puwadish (i > 1) Okdro (digits[i] == 0) Gihe Hehokgi
        i := i - 1.
    Kobihek
    Koke text := "".
    Gipolu j := i Wexdush 1 Drix -1 Gihe Hehokgi
        text := text ++ digits[j].
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu text.
}

Yokyi add_digits(a, b) {
    Koke result := [].
    Koke na := Yik(a).
    Koke nb := Yik(b).
    Koke carry := 0.
    Koke i := 1.
    Puwadish (i <= na) Dak (i <= nb) Dak (carry /= 0) Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke total := carry.
        Yopok i > na, try_b.
        total := total + a[i].
try_b:
        Yopok i > nb, save_digit.
        total := total + b[i].
save_digit:
        carry := -(-total / 10).
        Oxba(result, total - (carry * 10)).
        i := i + 1.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu decimal(result).
}

Yokyi multiply_digits(a, b) {
    Koke result := [].
    Koke size := Yik(a) + Yik(b).
    Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush size Gihe Hehokgi
        Oxba(result, 0).
    Kobihek
    Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush Yik(a) Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke x := a[i].
        Yopok x == 0, skip_row.
        Gipolu j := 1 Wexdush Yik(b) Gihe Hehokgi
            Koke p := i + j - 1.
            result[p] := result[p] + (x * b[j]).
        Kobihek
skip_row:
    Kobihek
    Koke carry := 0.
    Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush size Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke total := result[i] + carry.
        carry := -(-total / 10).
        result[i] := total - (carry * 10).
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu decimal(result).
}

</solution>

<solution task="t2-rpn">
Yokyi integer_token(token) {
    Koke i := 1.
    Yopok token[1] /= "-", check_digits.
    i := 2.
check_digits:
    Yopok i > Yik(token), invalid.
    Gipolu j := i Wexdush Yik(token) Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke c := token[j].
        Yopok (c < "0") Dak (c > "9"), invalid.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu Geklabik.
invalid:
    Pohuwu Lesh.
}

Yokyi trunc_div(a, b) {
    Koke q := a / b.
    Yopok (a < 0) /= (b < 0), done.
    Yopok a % b == 0, done.
    q := q - 1.
done:
    Pohuwu q.
}

Yokyi apply_op(op, a, b) {
    Dru op Ihedrux
    "+": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu a + b.
    Kobihek
    "-": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu a - b.
    Kobihek
    "*": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu a * b.
    Kobihek Kobihek
    Yopok b == 0, invalid.
    Koke q := trunc_div(a, b).
    Yopok op == "/", quotient.
    Pohuwu a - (b * q).
quotient:
    Pohuwu q.
invalid:
    Pohuwu Liliga.
}

Yokyi evaluate(line) {
    Koke stack := [].
    Koke top := 0.
    Koke i := 1.
    Koke n := Yik(line).
    Puwadish i <= n Gihe Hehokgi
        Yopok line[i] /= " ", read_token.
        i := i + 1.
        Gosh.
read_token:
        Koke token := "".
        Puwadish (i <= n) Okdro (line[i] /= " ") Gihe Hehokgi
            token := token ++ line[i].
            i := i + 1.
        Kobihek
        Koke value := Liliga.
        Dru token Ihedrux
        "+", "-", "*", "/", "%": Hehokgi
            Yopok top < 2, invalid.
            value := apply_op(token, stack[top - 1], stack[top]).
            Yopok value == Liliga, invalid.
            top := top - 2.
        Kobihek
        Hishyeko Hehokgi
            Yopok Gukdidok integer_token(token), invalid.
            value := Bupuxbo(token).
        Kobihek Kobihek
        top := top + 1.
        Yopok top <= Yik(stack), reuse_slot.
        Oxba(stack, value).
        Gosh.
reuse_slot:
        stack[top] := value.
    Kobihek
    Yopok top /= 1, invalid.
    Pohuwu stack[1].
invalid:
    Pohuwu "error".
}

Koke line := Pewexpo().
Puwadish line /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi
    Ebi evaluate(line).
    line := Pewexpo().
Kobihek
</solution>

    Yopok executed == 10000, timeout.
    executed := executed + 1.
    Koke instruction := program[pc].
    Koke op := instruction[1].
    Koke first := instruction[2].
    Koke x := value_of(first, registers).
    Yopok op == "out", output.
    Koke y := value_of(instruction[3], registers).
    Yopok op == "jnz", jump_instruction.
    Koke result := y.

        result := trunc_div(x, y).
        Yopok op == "div", store.
        result := x - (y * result).
    Kobihek Kobihek
store:
    registers[first[1]] := result.
    Uxdrush advance.

    Ebi x.
    Uxdrush advance.
jump_instruction:
    Yopok x == 0, advance.
    pc := pc + y.
    Gosh.

<solution task="t3-bigdiv">
Yokyi divisor_chunks(line, separator) {
    Koke chunks := [].
    Koke value := 0.
    Koke place := 1.
    Gipolu i := Yik(line) Wexdush separator + 1 Drix -1 Gihe Hehokgi
        value := value + (place * Bupuxbo(line[i])).
        place := place * 10.
        Yopok place /= 10000, next_digit.
        Oxba(chunks, value).
        value := 0.
        place := 1.
next_digit:
    Kobihek
    Yopok place == 1, extra_chunk.
    Oxba(chunks, value).
extra_chunk:
    Oxba(chunks, 0).
    Pohuwu chunks.
}

Yokyi multiply_small(chunks, digit) {
    Koke result := [].
    Koke carry := 0.
    Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush Yik(chunks) Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke value := (chunks[i] * digit) + carry.
        carry := -(-value / 10000).
        Oxba(result, value - (carry * 10000)).
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu result.
}

Yokyi at_least(a, b) {
    Gipolu i := Yik(a) Wexdush 1 Drix -1 Gihe Hehokgi
        Yopok a[i] > b[i], yes.
        Yopok a[i] < b[i], no.
    Kobihek
yes:
    Pohuwu Geklabik.
no:
    Pohuwu Lesh.
}

Yokyi subtract_chunks(a, b) {
    Koke borrow := 0.
    Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush Yik(a) Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke value := a[i] - b[i] - borrow.
        borrow := 0.
        Yopok value >= 0, save.
        value := value + 10000.
        borrow := 1.
save:
        a[i] := value.
    Kobihek
}

Yokyi format_chunks(chunks) {
    Koke i := Yik(chunks).
    Puwadish (i > 1) Okdro (chunks[i] == 0) Gihe Hehokgi
        i := i - 1.
    Kobihek
    Koke result := Yawishbo(chunks[i]).
    Gipolu j := i - 1 Wexdush 1 Drix -1 Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke part := Yawishbo(chunks[j]).
        Puwadish Yik(part) < 4 Gihe Hehokgi
            part := "0" ++ part.
        Kobihek
        result := result ++ part.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu result.
}

Yokyi divide_line(line) {
    Koke separator := 1.
    Puwadish line[separator] /= " " Gihe Hehokgi
        separator := separator + 1.
    Kobihek
    Koke divisor := divisor_chunks(line, separator).
    Koke remainder := multiply_small(divisor, 0).
    Koke multiples := [].
    Gipolu digit := 0 Wexdush 9 Gihe Hehokgi
        Oxba(multiples, multiply_small(divisor, digit)).
    Kobihek

    Koke quotient := "".
    Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush separator - 1 Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke carry := Bupuxbo(line[i]).
        Gipolu j := 1 Wexdush Yik(remainder) Gihe Hehokgi
            Koke value := remainder[j] * 10 + carry.
            carry := -(-value / 10000).
            remainder[j] := value - (carry * 10000).
        Kobihek
        Koke lo := 0.
        Koke hi := 10.
        Puwadish hi - lo > 1 Gihe Hehokgi
            Koke mid := (lo + hi) / 2.
            Yopok at_least(remainder, multiples[mid + 1]), move_lo.
            hi := mid.
            Gosh.
move_lo:
            lo := mid.
        Kobihek
        Yopok lo == 0, append_digit.
        subtract_chunks(remainder, multiples[lo + 1]).
append_digit:
        Yopok (lo == 0) Okdro (quotient == ""), skip_digit.
        quotient := quotient ++ lo.
skip_digit:
    Kobihek
    Yopok quotient /= "", print_result.
    quotient := "0".
print_result:
    Ebi quotient ++ " " ++ format_chunks(remainder).
}

Koke line := Pewexpo().
Puwadish line /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi
    divide_line(line).
    line := Pewexpo().
Kobihek
</solution>

<solution task="t3-calc">
Yokyi peek(parser) {
    Koke text := parser[1].
    Koke pos := parser[2].
    Puwadish pos <= Yik(text) Gihe Hehokgi
        Yopok text[pos] /= " ", found.
        pos := pos + 1.
    Kobihek
    parser[2] := pos.
    Pohuwu "".
found:
    parser[2] := pos.
    Pohuwu text[pos].
}

Yokyi digit(c) {
    Pohuwu (c >= "0") Okdro (c <= "9").
}

Yokyi precedence(op) {
    Dru op Ihedrux
    "+", "-": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu 1.
    Kobihek
    "*", "/", "%": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu 2.
    Kobihek Kobihek
    Pohuwu 0.
}

Yokyi arithmetic(op, a, b) {
    Dru op Ihedrux
    "+": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu a + b.
    Kobihek
    "-": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu a - b.
    Kobihek
    "*": Hehokgi
        Pohuwu a * b.
    Kobihek Kobihek
    Yopok b == 0, invalid.
    Koke q := a / b.
    Yopok (a < 0) /= (b < 0), quotient_ready.
    Yopok a % b == 0, quotient_ready.
    q := q - 1.
quotient_ready:
    Yopok op == "/", quotient.
    Pohuwu a - (b * q).
quotient:
    Pohuwu q.
invalid:
    Pohuwu Liliga.
}

Yokyi expression(parser, minimum) {
    Koke negative := Lesh.
    Koke c := peek(parser).
    Puwadish c == "-" Gihe Hehokgi
        negative := Gukdidok negative.
        parser[2] := parser[2] + 1.
        c := peek(parser).
    Kobihek
    Koke value := 0.
    Yopok c == "(", parenthesized.
    Yopok Gukdidok digit(c), invalid.
    Koke text := parser[1].
    Koke i := parser[2].
    Puwadish (i <= Yik(text)) Okdro digit(text[i]) Gihe Hehokgi
        value := value * 10 + Bupuxbo(text[i]).
        i := i + 1.
    Kobihek
    parser[2] := i.
    Uxdrush unary_done.
parenthesized:
    parser[2] := parser[2] + 1.
    value := expression(parser, 1).
    Yopok value == Liliga, invalid.
    Yopok peek(parser) /= ")", invalid.
    parser[2] := parser[2] + 1.
unary_done:
    Yopok Gukdidok negative, operators.
    value := -value.
operators:
    Puwadish Geklabik Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke op := peek(parser).
        Koke level := precedence(op).
        Yopok level < minimum, done.
        parser[2] := parser[2] + 1.
        Koke right := expression(parser, level + 1).
        Yopok right == Liliga, invalid.
        value := arithmetic(op, value, right).
        Yopok value == Liliga, invalid.
    Kobihek
done:
    Pohuwu value.
invalid:
    Pohuwu Liliga.
}

Yokyi calculate(line) {
    Koke parser := [line, 1].
    Koke result := expression(parser, 1).
    Yopok (result == Liliga) Dak (peek(parser) /= ""), invalid.
    Pohuwu result.
invalid:
    Pohuwu "error".
}

Koke line := Pewexpo().
Puwadish line /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi
    Ebi calculate(line).
    line := Pewexpo().
Kobihek
</solution>
